items.label: Multi-Functional Transform Truck Toys
items.value: Our truck toy for ejecting container rail cars has dual launcher tracks, one-touch ejection function, inertial driving, parking lot and storage space. Enhances your child's fine hand-eye coordination and early preschool development, providing them with endless fun and stimulation.

items.label: Easy to Start Competition and Play
items.value: 8pcs die-cast race cars (Random Style). Open the catapult competition function, there has ultra long dual racing tracks, which can be used for single-player or multi-player competition. Make it easy for kids to play with their favorite toy cars, it is a great toy for kids to interact together.

items.label: 3-in-1 Carrier Truck Toys
items.value: This transport truck ideas a foldable design, it features a catapult track container car and a storage compartment for 8pcs colorful die-cast race cars, comes with the flashing lights and makes various traffic horn sounds, providing a complete transport experience for young car enthusiasts. Also includes traffic signs and race signs for any race challenge.

items.label: Lightweight and Safe
items.value: Our transport car carrier truck toy for kids is made of high-quality materials that can withstand rough play while keeping your child safe. This ejection truck requires 2xAA batteries (Not Included).

items.label: Enlightenment Educationl Gift for 2 3 4 5 6 Years Old Kids
items.value: Whether it is birthday or Christmas and Halloween, or other kinds of kids parties, it is a perfect car track carrier truck toys gift idea for boys and girls over 3 4 5 6 years old.

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: 1. Remove the toy from its packaging. 2. Assemble the 3-layer foldable track. 3. Place the transport car carrier truck on the track. 4. Load the 8 race cars onto the truck's container car. 5. Use the one-touch ejection function to launch the cars. 6. Race the cars on the dual racing tracks. 7. Store the race cars in the truck's storage compartment when not in use.
